name: Polyseat 0.1.0
body:
**Several people playing on one Linux PC at the same time.** Each in their own
isolated session with their own Steam account, their own controller and their
own screen, streamed to their own Moonlight client. The machine's regular
desktop keeps running undisturbed while they play.

A seat is an Incus system container with its own headless Sway, its own
Sunshine, its own PipeWire and its own Steam account. One GPU serves all of
them. Polyseat implements neither a compositor, nor an encoder, nor a streaming
protocol: it builds the seats, wires them up collision free, assigns input,
shares the game library and repairs what drifts.

This is the first release, and the state the project was in when it stopped
being an experiment. Everything in it has been run on the machine it was written
on: one Arch host with an RTX 4080, seats streaming 4K to Apple TVs over
Moonlight, installed and uninstalled from scratch once to make sure the
instructions are the instructions.

## Install

```
git clone --branch v0.1.0 https://github.com/superuser404notfound/Polyseat.git
cd Polyseat
sudo host/install.sh
sudo systemctl enable --now polyseatd
```

Then open `https://<this machine>:47800`, choose a password, and add a seat.

## Read before installing

- **Arch based hosts only.** The installer queries pacman rather than pretending
  to be portable.
- **The AMD path has never run on real hardware.** It is written and reasoned
  about in [docs/amd.md](docs/amd.md), and NVIDIA is what has been used.
- **A host NVIDIA driver update needs seats provisioned again**, or Sunshine in
  them falls back to the software encoder.
- **The shared game library needs a filesystem that can share blocks**, which
  means btrfs or XFS made with `reflink=1`. Seats work without one; the library
  simply stays off.
- **Nothing checks for a newer Polyseat.** Updating is checking out the newer
  tag and running the installer again, which now restarts the daemon for you.

The full list of what is in it, and what it does not do, is in
[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/superuser404notfound/Polyseat/blob/v0.1.0/CHANGELOG.md).

There are no binaries here on purpose: the installer builds from this source,
because a binary of unknown provenance running as root is worse than a compiler.
